Get the Source Metadata of a Result

Source: R/metadata.R
sourceInfo.Rd

Returns the provenance record that every data object of helvetia carries. Use it to cite a source correctly, to see which stand or version a cached result is based on, or to reproduce a download exactly.

Usage

sourceInfo(x)

Arguments

x

an object returned by one of the data functions, e.g. gemeinde() or popGemeinde().

Value

An object of class SourceInfo, a list with the elements

source

description of the source.

url

exact request URL(s).

retrievedAt

time of the download.

checksum

MD5 checksum of a downloaded file, else NA.

version

source version, stand or period, else NA.

query

POST selections sent to the source (PXWeb), else NULL; the URL alone does not describe such a request.

notes

further remarks, or NULL.

NULL if x carries no metadata.

Details

The record is stored in the attribute "source" and survives the cache: a cached result reports the time of its original download, not of the cache hit.

See also

Other swiss.source: cacheList()

Examples

sourceInfo(kanton())
#> Source:     Official cantonal numbering and names (BFS)
#> URL:        /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/helvetia/extdata/kanton.csv
#> Retrieved:  2026-10-16 00:00:00 UTC
